documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Approval Of The Un-Audited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) Of The Company For The Second Quarter (Q2) And Half Year Ended September 30, 2026.
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Stylam Industries held its Q1 FY27 earnings conference call, reporting healthy margins and discussing plans for its upcoming plant. Management stated that the commercial production of the new plant is expected to start by September 1, 2026, with dry run trials already underway. The company is also restructuring its domestic business through new team building and distributor addition, expecting results from Q3 onwards. Furthermore, management noted that strategic partner Aica has joined the board, and technology transfer discussions may take place in the future. Stylam Industries Limited reported a 15% increase in revenue for Q1 FY27 compared to the same period last year and stated confidence in achieving its financial guidance.

guidance.claim: Management stated that revenue of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores can be easily achieved from the third plant in the current financial year.
guidance.quote: I think based on the value of what you were saying, around INR250 crores to INR300 crores, it would be easily achieved from the third plant.

guidance.claim: Stylam expressed confidence in meeting its financial guidance.
guidance.quote: Stylam is confident in achieving its financial guidance, indicating sustained momentum for growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects to generate between INR300 crores and INR400 crores in turnover from the new plant in the next three quarters.
guidance.quote: But we are quite hopeful that we can get INR300 crores, INR400 crores turnover from this plant in the next 3 quarters.

guidance.claim: Management targets INR250 crores to INR300 crores from the new plant for the financial year.
guidance.quote: For this financial year, I think we will target INR250 crores to INR300 crores from that particular plant.

guidance.claim: The company expects to target around 80% utilization for the new plant next year.
guidance.quote: And next year, we would be targeting around 80% utilization.

guidance.claim: Management estimates a revenue increase of 20% to 25% compared to the previous year.
guidance.quote: We cannot, it will be definitely 20%, 25% increase than the previous.

guidance.claim: The acrylic segment revenue is targeted to reach between INR50 crores and INR70 crores.
guidance.quote: I think this year, we would be doing INR50 crores to INR60 crores, INR50 crores to INR70 crores.

guidance.claim: Peak capacity from the new plant is estimated to reach INR900 crores to INR1,000 crores.
guidance.quote: I think we complete -- we can do around INR900 crores to INR1,000 crores from the new plant.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects domestic market improvements and better numbers starting from Quarter 3 onwards.
demand_outlook.quote: And you will definitely see the results from Quarter 3. I won't even say Quarter 2, but you will see the results from Quarter 3 onwards.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the export market is going positive for the company with good performance in Europe, APAC, and the Middle East.
demand_outlook.quote: Further ahead I think APAC region and Middle East. So, I think to be honest it's going positive for us in the export market.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's expansion highlights its ability to meet rising global demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The groundwork for the new plant is underway, enhancing our ability to meet rising global demand with greater speed and scale.

demand_outlook.claim: Rapid advancement in expansion highlights commitment to meeting increasing market demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The rapid advancement in expansion highlights Stylam's commitment to enhancing production capacity and meeting increasing market demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Management states that demand remains strong and people will continue buying despite price increases.
demand_outlook.quote: If there's a price increase, people will still keep on buying. It is not that if the prices go up, people will stop buying it and stop construction.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of the new plant is scheduled to start by September 1, 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production would be 1st of September, first week of September.

capex_expansion.claim: Management plans to announce new capex after the current plant becomes operational by the end of August or early September.
capex_expansion.quote: So that is why, once plant is operated by end August, early September, definitely we will announce about our new capex.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that dry run trials for the new plant are already going on.
capex_expansion.quote: Dry run, dry run trial is already going on.

capex_expansion.claim: Stylam is setting up a new plant for laminate manufacturing adjoining its existing facility in Manak Tabra.
capex_expansion.quote: Stylam is setting up a new state-of-the-art plant for the manufacturing of laminates, just adjoining to its existing plant in Manak Tabra, Panchkula, Haryana.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is commissioning a new greenfield manufacturing facility as its third laminate plant.
capex_expansion.quote: Stylam Industries is strengthening its leadership position with commissioning of new green-field manufacturing facility, our third laminate plant, strategically located next to our existing facility at Manak Tabra in Panchkula, Haryana

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the new expansion plant is progressing well.
capex_expansion.quote: The construction of the new expansion plant is progressing well.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of the third greenfield laminate plant in Manak Tabra is expected to start between end of June and middle of July.
capex_expansion.quote: Hopefully it will be maximum middle of July, minimum end of June, it will start commercial production.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capital expenditure incurred for the new plant is INR334 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: We have at this moment done the capex of INR334 crores.

margins_costs.claim: Management confirmed that the margin performance was driven by efficiency and higher utilization rather than inventory gains.
margins_costs.quote: No, no inventory gain. nothing. It is our efficiency and it is our more utilization and if you go for sales figures it is increased.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that raw material prices and price hikes taken remain intact.
margins_costs.quote: The raw material still remains the same condition. I think whatever price hike we have taken; it would remain intact.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that losses in the domestic market have been reduced.
margins_costs.quote: I think the losses have been reduced, that is the only thing which might be an improvement in the margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company enhanced the share of value-added products and improved net gross margins.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced the share of value-added products in the product mix, expanded the product range, and improved net gross margins.

margins_costs.claim: The company has increased prices in the domestic market in two tranches and tried to do so in the export market where possible.
margins_costs.quote: In domestic market, we did in 2 tranches. In export market, we have tried wherever it is possible.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin was reported at 39% in the fourth quarter.
Material margin or RMC gross margins reached 49% in the fourth quarter.
margins_costs.quote: I think it was 49% in the fourth quarter.

orders_capacity.claim: The laminates division reached approximately 74% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: The company reached approximately 74% capacity utilization in the laminates division following modular expansions at existing facilities, increasing overall capacity.

orders_capacity.claim: Stylam operates a laminate manufacturing plant in Asia with an annual capacity of 20 million sheets.
orders_capacity.quote: Stylam operates one of the largest single location laminate manufacturing plants in Asia, spread across 80 acres having an annual capacity of 20 million sheets.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 3.17 million sheets during Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Company has sold 3.17 Mn Sheets during the Q1 FY27 (Domestic - 1.10 Mn & Export 2.07 Mn) as compared to 3.27 Mn Sheets in Q4 FY26 (Domestic - 1.06 Mn & Export 2.21 Mn).

orders_capacity.claim: Hot coating technology production capacity is 1 million laminates per year.
orders_capacity.quote: World’s latest Hot Coating technology with production capacity of 1 million laminates per year.

orders_capacity.claim: The laminate division achieved a 74% capacity utilization in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: the laminate division achieved a 74% capacity utilization in FY26.

capital_allocation.claim: Stylam became and remained a net debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: Became a net debt-free company and maintained this status, even after establishing a new plant.

capital_allocation.claim: Stylam maintains its status as a zero-debt entity.
capital_allocation.quote: Stylam maintains its status as a zero-debt entity, reflecting strong financial health and effective capital management.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management pointed out logistics as a very big problem globally, including for the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: In fact, for the entire world right now logistics is a very big problem, but that is a part of the business.

risks_headwinds.claim: The plant delay was caused by needing to meet environmental clearance requirements following a Supreme Court observation.
risks_headwinds.quote: Actually, in last year, maybe October, November, there was some Supreme Court observation in this area -- clarification, we need to have to meet EC, environment clearance.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production of the new plant is targeted to begin by September 1, 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Commercial production would be 1st of September, first week of September.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects domestic market revenue performance to show significant improvement starting from Quarter 3.
management_commitments.quote: Definitely Q3 you'll see a significant ramp-up.

management_commitments.claim: Management committed to announcing a new capex once the current plant is operational by the end of August or early September.
management_commitments.quote: So that is why, once plant is operated by end August, early September, definitely we will announce about our new capex.

management_commitments.claim: Management states that the new plant will start commercial production by a minimum of the end of June to a maximum of mid-July.
management_commitments.quote: Hopefully it will be maximum middle of July, minimum end of June, it will start commercial production.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to achieve 80% plus capacity utilization of the new plant in the next 2 years.
management_commitments.quote: And that is why what we were saying that the ramp-ups definitely in the next 2 years, we will be able to achieve 80% plus capacity utilization of the new plant.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
